hack2hire:68fa7c5e0fa32e4d82f4fc1f.reference: keep a dictionary of pattern to handler and, per query, test every pattern of the right length and keep the best (wildcard count, wildcard positions) key
hack2hire:68fa7c5e0fa32e4d82f4fc1f.candidate_design: segment trie whose children are literal segments plus one "*" child; a query walks the trie depth first, literal child before "*", carrying the wildcard count, pruning branches whose count already exceeds the best complete match, and keeps the first best match found in that order
hack2hire:68fa7c5e0fa32e4d82f4fc1f.complexity_target: O(min(T, 2^L)) per call worst case, T = trie nodes, L = path segments; O(L) per addRoute/O(total pattern segments) space

hack2hire:686b0a7af56e0403f35f23ee.reference: quadratic dynamic programme over the last chosen index and the number of changes used so far, trying every earlier index as the predecessor
hack2hire:686b0a7af56e0403f35f23ee.candidate_design: dynamic programme keyed by value: best[v][j] is the longest subsequence ending in value v with j changes, and top[j] the best over all values; each element extends best[v][j] by one or starts a new run after top[j - 1], updating j from k down to 0
hack2hire:686b0a7af56e0403f35f23ee.complexity_target: O(n * k) time/O(d * k) space, d = distinct values

hack2hire:67799006dcf91f8e3c1c310d.reference: bottom-up dynamic programming table over prefixes of s and p
hack2hire:67799006dcf91f8e3c1c310d.candidate_design: split p at "*" into literal pieces; the first piece must be a prefix of s and the last a suffix (when p has a "*"), and each middle piece is placed at its leftmost occurrence after the previous one, which is optimal because "*" absorbs any gap
hack2hire:67799006dcf91f8e3c1c310d.complexity_target: O(|s| * |p|) worst case with a linear substring search, usually near linear/O(|p|) space

hack2hire:67e45b2850b60b77022f382e.reference: for every pair of positions i < j check pattern[i] == pattern[j] exactly when word[i] == word[j]
hack2hire:67e45b2850b60b77022f382e.candidate_design: per word, one pass with two maps (pattern character to word character and back), failing at the first conflict

hack2hire:67730b5ddd9437f8aa275b04.reference: scan every block on every write

hack2hire:67730b5ddd9437f8aa275b04.complexity_target: O(n) to build plus O(log n) per write/O(n) space

hack2hire:679da470996c3c60bd38b5ba.reference: remember every attack and, per query, test each unit segment of the base

hack2hire:679da470996c3c60bd38b5ba.complexity_target: O(1) expected per call/O(min(n, attacks)) space

hack2hire:678876fe402dc47b67a14944.reference: simulate every operation: pick the largest available value, then rewrite the state string by the unblocking rule
hack2hire:678876fe402dc47b67a14944.candidate_design: index i becomes available before operation d(i) + 1, where d(i) is its distance to the nearest "1" at or to its left; bucket values by d, then S[t] is the running maximum over buckets 0..t

hack2hire:67a56d81b571d6ff0a4bd238.reference: dynamic programme over subsets of servers already brought down (the elapsed rounds are the sum of their hit counts)

hack2hire:67840e27d0faf7ec64cc3adb.reference: three nested loops over all index triples
